subject: Keys and Mattocks
text: Stock up on at least a couple stacks of Keys and Mattocks before entering dungeons to avoid getting stuck.

evidence.quote: stock up on at least a couple stacks of Keys and Mattocks before dungeons, then you won't have to worry about getting stuck like the first time i tried this game years ago.

subject: Morning Star
text: After obtaining the Morning Star, Mattocks are no longer needed.

evidence.quote: once you get the Morning Star you don't need Mattocks period

subject: Missable achievements
text: Some achievements are missable, and knowing which dungeons to watch out for helps avoid missing them.

evidence.quote: the missable achievements arent too bad if you know which dungeons to watch out for, thanks to people in the comments under achievements for that.

subject: Grinding
text: Leaving one enemy alive on a screen lets enemies respawn instantly when you switch screens, which helps with grinding.

evidence.quote: also if you ever need to grind (for leveling or loot), leave one enemy alive on a screen so that enemies can instantly respawn when you switch screens

subject: World map
text: A commenter recommends consulting a world map while travelling the overworld, since finding points after reaching water cost them time.

evidence.quote: I would recommend looking up a world map while travelling overworld, I think two hours of my play time was wasted on trying to find certain points once I could start traveling over water.

subject: Inventory
text: Inventory swapping is a dated mechanic that takes some adjustment but is manageable.

evidence.quote: Of course a few mechanics haven't dated well, but once you get adjusted to all the inventory swapping, it's mostly fine.

subject: Hail Hydra!
text: A commenter offers to send a save from before the Hydra boss to players who did not get the achievement.

evidence.quote: fixed, pm me if you didn't get it and want a save before the boss
